newsitem.title: USA: AMERICAN FOOTBALL-FLORIDA MAKES CASE FOR NATIONAL TITLE.
newsitem.headline: AMERICAN FOOTBALL-FLORIDA MAKES CASE FOR NATIONAL TITLE.

text.p: Third-ranked Florida staked a claim to its first national championship behind Danny Wuerffel's three touchdown passes and a scoring scamper in a 52-20 victory over top-ranked Florida State in the Sugar Bowl.

Wuerffel, this year's Heissman Trophy winner as the nation's top college football player, connected on touchdown passes -- nine, 31 and seven yards -- to Ike Hilliard in each of the first three quarters and added a 47-yard completion to the him to set up another score.
The third touchdown pass to Hilliard began a 28-point explosion that broke open a close game and enabled the Gators to avenge a 24-21 setback to Florida State on November 30th.
The Florida State Seminoles were denied their second national title in four years and allowed their highest point total since a 59-27 loss to Auburn in 1985.

The defeat was particularly bitter for Florida State coach Bobby Bowden, since it came against Gators' coach Steve Spurrier, who spent the past week complaining about late hits on Wuerffel the last time the two teams played each other in November, when Florida State won 24-21.
Tonight was just Spurrier's third win against Bowden in nine tries.
